findings.challenged_claim: Root: TS preparation failure can retain earlier default before plan installation

source_derived_unexecuted_witness.input: Fresh owner seq0; normalizeSchema({contracts:{C:{fields:{a:{type:"text",default:"kept"},b:{type:"decimal",default:"1"}}}}}); explicitly recordFactoryProvenance(schema,owner.scope.ownerRevision), then registerValidationPlan.
source_derived_unexecuted_witness.trace: 430 reserves sequence0; field a registers default at 0:contracts.C.fields.a. Field b canonical default is Decimal; copyFrozenValue rejects class prototype at199-200 before plan install523. Registration throws uncopyable-value; no PlanId returned.
source_derived_unexecuted_witness.retained: owner state contains earlier "kept" default. resolvePlanDefault(owner,{kind:"default-ref",key:"0:contracts.C.fields.a"}) can resolve it because resolution uses key shape/map, not returned-ref issuance. release guessed seq0 PlanId finds no plan and leaves default. Repetition while same owner live adds one unreachable published-plan default per failure.

findings.qualification_or_correction: Without explicit integrator-private hook the actual first failure is missing-provenance411-416, before sequence/default mutation. normalizeSchema only records its own factorySchemas weakset; it does not call prepared hook. This is a conditional prepared primitive/test-stand-in failure, not current public validateValue or production registration leak. Sequence advancement alone is not a correctness defect; unpublished default retention is the material effect. WeakMap state is reclaimed when owner becomes unreachable.
findings.required_outcome_or_proposed_gate: Stage draft copies/defaults locally and publish after complete successful copy, or roll back only keys created by failed attempt. Preserve previously published default identity; no new security policy. Existing Decimal acceptance mismatch remains separate compatibility/adoption issue.

TS NativePlanRegistry retirement clears handle live set and marks stale, does not touch TS plan/default data. releaseValidationPlan deletes plan only; Rust release sets plan slot None only.
source_derived_unexecuted_witness.distinction: Successful held-ref content is not LR01 failed-registration orphan. Native retirement still occupies plan bound until explicit release (N2), TS handle generation retirement frees its live bound; recorded divergence.

findings.qualification_or_correction: N3 and tests directly establish retirement retention, not automatic deletion after successful retirement.
